data.name: Hazem
data.gender_notes: Hazem is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hazem means 'strong' or 'brave' in Arabic, symbolizing a person who exudes courage and resilience. It is a name often associated with strength and power. The name Hazem carries the meaning “Strong, Brave, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hazem usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hazem is also mentioned in Hadith as a name of the Prophet Muhammad's companion, known for his bravery and loyalty.
data.etymology: Hazem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Brave, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hazem total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.long_meaning: حازم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الذي يقطع الأمور بحزم و نهائي ، و الحازم هو الذي يضبط الأمور و يحكمها بقوة و صرامة ، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الشجاعة في الشخصية

in_urdu.name: حازم
in_urdu.meaning: حازم کا مطلب ہے فیصلہ کرنے میں مضبوط اور مستحکم شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حازم (حازم) نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی معاملے کو حزم سے قطع کرنا یا فیصلہ کرنا، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ مضبوط شخصیت اور فیصلے کی استحکام کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے
